description: concept-db's resolve-island upkeep activity runs: SELECT * FROM concept WHERE relevance > 0.3 AND (SELECT count() FROM concept_edge WHERE from_concept = concept.id OR to_concept = concept.id GROUP ALL)[0].count == 0 ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 10. The relevance filter matches 60,800 of 63,611 concept rows (nearly the whole table), and SurrealDB evaluates the correlated concept_edge subquery for every matching row BEFORE the ORDER BY/LIMIT 10 is applied -- tens of thousands of subquery evaluations per cycle against a 22,312-row concept_edge table. This times out ('The operation timed out') and re-fires every UPKEEP_INTERVAL_MS (default 300000ms/5min) via the upkeep scheduler, contributing sustained SurrealDB CPU/IO load. Observed as part of a 2026-08-29 thermal emergency (Tctl 100C). Emergency mitigation: stopped concept-db's upkeep scheduler live via POST /upkeep/scheduler/stop (confirmed running:false) -- this is NOT a code fix and the scheduler is currently OFF, meaning split-long-concept, adjust-priority-relevance, prune-irrelevant-neighbors, decay-stale-relevance, and prune-per-execution-concepts are also not running. Needs: rewrite resolve-island's query to bound the candidate set (e.g. pre-filter to a small recent/unchecked window, or track a checked-at watermark) before the correlated subquery, then re-enable the scheduler.
